author: mostafa_gawad
title: JUMP ANIMATION Hiring Vector Background Artists
content: WE'RE HIRING! – VECTOR BACKGROUND ARTISTS. JUMP ANIMATION is looking for talented Vector Background Artists to join our upcoming animated series project! Requirements: Strong skills in creating 2D vector backgrounds. Proficiency in Adobe Illustrator or Adobe Animate. Ability to match an established cartoon art style. Attention to detail and good artistic skills. Project Duration: 2–3 Months (Freelance). Send your CV and Portfolio to: jobs@jumpanimation.com or gawad26@gmail.com. You can also message us directly through Facebook!

author: whenthesilentbirdsings
title: Hiring Comic Artists, Writers & More for When the Silent Bird Sings
content: HIRING COMIC ARTISTS, WRITERS & MORE. We're looking for help with “When the Silent Bird Sings” and other studio projects. Positions include: Lineartist, sketch artist, colorist, storyboard artist, animators, music producers, language translators, comic writers/editors, personal assistants, video/reel editors/promoters, content creators & more. These positions are paid but we're open to collaboration / internships. Please send a PROFESSIONAL email to: whenthesilentbirdsings@gmail.com with: Name, general location, Position applying for, Resume/Portfolio, Rate per panel & for 60 panels, Rates for services, Turnaround Time, Programs / Software used, Preferred Payment Method (PayPal). NO DEADLINE, ROLLING APPLICATION ACCEPTANCE. ABSOLUTELY NO AI USE IN THE PROCESS OR FINAL DELIVERABLES.

author: adcorp._
title: AdCorp Hiring Illustration Artist (Detail Work Specialist)

Send your portfolio to: adcorphelp@gmail.com Subject: Illustration Artist Application. WhatsApp: 0319-8296653
